name: WWWA World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Held by Razor for the whole of this record without a single defense shown; still his when the record ends.

name: WWWA World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Changed hands once in this record, when a distracted referee missed a successful cover and a rival stable's own cover counted instead.

name: WWWA Cruiserweight Championship
epitaph: Vacated by a champion's sudden retirement, handed to a new champion by decree, then lost to a masked challenger who turned out to be a returning wrestler.

name: WWWA Hardcore Championship
epitaph: Created for an eight-man parking garage battle royal and successfully defended in a boiler room brawl two weeks later.
